eas_text: A civil authority has issued A CHILD ABDUCTION EMERGENCY for the following counties or areas: Monroe; St. Clair; Washtenaw; Wayne; Oakland; Lenawee; Macomb, MI; at 3:21 AM on AUG 21, 2023 Effective until 5:21 AM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: Amber Alert issued for abduction of two twin infants, Matthew Jace Bridges and Montana Alexander Bridges.  Abducted by two African-American females in Livonia, MI.  Last seen in a black colored Jeep Cherokee with chrome trim around rear passenger windows.  Any information please call the Livonia Police Department at 734-466-2470 ext. 2 or call 911.
